title: Retail Electricity Prices
scope: Covers the all-sector average retail price of electricity by state and for the United States, plus retail sales, net generation, net summer capacity, and per-capita sales and generation where a Census population figure joins, calendar years 2012 through 2024. The U.S. figure is EIA's published U.S. Total row, a sales-weighted all-sector average, never an unweighted mean of the state prices. Also covers residential, commercial, and industrial average prices from the same EIA-861 Total Electric Industry file. Does NOT cover: utility, city, or customer class rates; forecasts or what prices will do next year; bill calculators or rate-case advice; other fuels.
vintage_note: Rebuilt from EIA Form EIA-861 historical state file (HS861 2010-), Total Electric Industry, through 2024, on 2026-08-15 by scripts/refresh_dl04.py. All-sector prices and sales for 2023 and 2024 were checked cell-by-cell against Electric Power Annual table 2.10 (SRC-401). Generation is EIA-923 annual state totals (SRC-403). Net summer capacity is EIA-860 (SRC-404). Population is Census vintage 2025 for 2020 forward and the 2010-2020 vintage file for 2012-2019 (SRC-402). Massachusetts 2023 all-sector price 23.21 cents per kWh matches both EIA publications and the recovered Retail-Price Electricity extract.

SRC-401.label: EIA Form EIA-861 / Electric Power Annual table 2.10
SRC-401.what: All-sector, residential, commercial, and industrial average retail prices (cents per kWh) and retail sales (MWh) by state, including the U.S. Total row
SRC-401.cadence: Annual; Electric Power Annual and the EIA-861 historical state file typically land in October for the prior calendar year

SRC-402.label: Census Bureau, state population estimates
SRC-402.what: July 1 resident population used for per-capita sales and generation

SRC-403.label: EIA-923 / annual generation by state
SRC-403.what: Net electricity generation (MWh), Total Electric Power Industry, all energy sources

SRC-404.label: EIA-860 / existing capacity by state
SRC-404.what: Net summer capacity (MW), Total Electric Power Industry, all sources
SRC-404.next_release: 2025 annual, expected with the next EIA-860 release

derived.note: Precomputed from the series above; prefer these over recomputing. Prices and sales cite (SRC-401). Rankings, year-over-year changes, and per-capita figures cite (derived, SRC-401) or (derived, SRC-401, SRC-402). Generation cites (SRC-403). Capacity cites (SRC-404). Never average the 50 state prices to produce a U.S. figure; use latest.us.price_cents.

verification.paths: HS861 Total Electric Industry Total price versus Electric Power Annual table 2.10 All Sectors for 2023 and 2024; overlapping cells matched to 0.01 cents. Massachusetts 2023 = 23.21 also matches the recovered Retail-Price Electricity extract.
